gaps.explanation: Re-read p9 (Exhibit 7, Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds). It prints five enterprise columns: Electric, Water, Water Pollution Control, BASWA and Sanitation. Electric, Water and WPC are already in detail from their budget schedules (H-2 p28, H-5 p30, H-8 p32). BASWA and Sanitation have no schedule in the trim (trimmed pp28-33 cover only Electric, Water and WPC; pp34-36 are governmental department schedules), and none of their lines are in detail. Printed BASWA column: Charges for services 2,349,347, Investment earnings 39,542, Miscellaneous revenues 131,803. Printed Sanitation column: Charges for services 2,745,489, Miscellaneous revenues 7,278. No transfers row is printed in any proprietary column; Capital Contributions for BASWA and Sanitation print '-'. Added 5,273,459: 23,950,113 + 5,273,459 = 29,223,572 vs statement 29,198,786. The remaining -24,786 is printed in the report: Water 'Gain on disposal of capital asset' 24,786 (p9 Water column and p30, detail index 186) is a revenue line in detail, while the statement JSON lines carry only the net Total-column 'Gain (loss) on disposal of capital asset' (7,889) as one disbursement (p9). Nothing derived is added for it.

gaps.explanation: Same two columns (p9). BASWA: Administrative and general expense 889,727 + Depreciation 430,568 + Operating contracts 628,154 (= printed Total Operating Expenses 1,948,449) + Interest expense (32,590) = 1,981,039. Sanitation: Operating and maintenance expenses 1,347,037 + Depreciation 286,776 + Operating contracts 997,246 (= printed 2,631,059) + Interest expense (25,654) = 2,656,713. Added 4,637,752: 20,324,510 + 4,637,752 = 24,962,262 vs statement 24,937,476. The remaining 24,786 is the same printed gross-vs-net item as revenue: detail holds WPC 'Gain (loss) on disposal of capital asset' (32,675) as spending (index 199, p32/p9) while the statement JSON carries the net Total (7,889); 32,675 - 7,889 = 24,786 = Water gain. Nothing derived is added. Cross-check of totals: Operating and maintenance 4,806,440 = 1,513,889 + 1,173,991 + 771,523 + 1,347,037; Administrative and general 2,740,296 = 997,763 + 540,063 + 312,743 + 889,727; Operating contracts 1,625,400 = 628,154 + 997,246; Interest (77,304) = 3,347 + 11,528 + 4,185 + 32,590 + 25,654.
